stepExplanation: Good dichotomous key characteristics are: 1) Observable and measurable, 2) Consistent (don't change with age, season, etc.), 3) Contrasting between groups. 'Presence/absence of backbone' is ideal - it's a fixed characteristic. Color can vary, size can change with age, and location doesn't define the organism.
stepBody: Which characteristic would be BEST to use in a dichotomous key for animals?
